style: Create original high-fantasy game art with chunky hand-inked dark contours, flat gouache-like color masses and restrained dry-brush texture, matching a painted fantasy deckbuilder. This art belongs to ONE playable hero, an original boy spellblade, and shows his power only through his motifs: glowing pale-blue mana orbs, a silver vambrace and blade of pale-blue light, blue runes, ice-cyan crystals and silver filigree. Never draw his face or body. Palette: deep navy #1B2A55, sapphire, ice cyan, pale-blue light #7FD3FF, silver and white; absolutely no purple or violet. Bold readable silhouettes, two-step cel shading; reserve soft emission for mana and runes. Do not imitate any existing game, champion, franchise character, emblem or official artwork. Include no text, letters, numerals, labels, logos or watermarks.
